description: This file defines the 'Language' class within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Common' namespace. It handles language-related operations such as displaying available languages, changing the current language, and saving language preferences for the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing language selection and storage in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays available languages and sets the current language based on cookies or configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves language selection, including setting cookies and redirecting appropriately.
